Australia has a thriving medical technology sector featuring major global pioneers, specialized contract manufacturers, and critical care producers. Prominent local and international companies include ResMed (respiratory and sleep apnea devices), Cochlear (hearing implants), [Cook Medical](https://www.cookmedical.com.au/) (minimally invasive devices), [Romar Engineering](https://romareng.com.au/medical-device-manufacturing/) (precision advanced manufacturing), and [Sabre Medical](https://sabremedical.com.au/) (cleanroom assembly and packaging). [](https://romareng.com.au/medical-device-manufacturing/)

- **ResMed:** Global headquarters in Sydney, specializing in cloud-connected sleep apnea and ventilator devices.

- **Cochlear:** Headquartered in Sydney, world-renowned for implantable hearing solutions.

- **Cook Medical:** Operates a major regional manufacturing and distribution facility in Brisbane

- **Medical Developments International:** Melbourne-based firm known for producing the Penthrox inhaler ("green whistle") and pain management devices. [](https://www.cookmedical.com.au/)

### Contract Manufacturing & Production Specialists

- **Romar Engineering:** Sydney-based precision manufacturer offering advanced manufacturing for medical tubing, seals, and surgical components.

- **Sabre Medical:** Lane Cove-based medical device manufacturer and packaging hub equipped with ISO cleanrooms.

- **ITL BioMedical:** Canberra-based developer and manufacturer of medical safety devices and sampling systems. [](https://romareng.com.au/medical-device-manufacturing/)

### Regulation and Industry Bodies

- **TGA (Therapeutic Goods Administration):** All devices must be registered in the Australian Register of Therapeutic Goods (ARTG) and adhere to strict quality management and Unique Device Identification (UDI) mandates.

- **MTAA (Medical Technology Association of Australia):** The national peak body representing manufacturers and suppliers in the sector. [](https://www.tga.gov.au/products/medical-devices/manufacturing/manufacture-medical-device)
